source_note: The with side's CLAUDE.md holds exactly the four NEVER rules from the day 8 brief and nothing else; the without side has no CLAUDE.md. check_rules.py runs on both sides and counts breaks per rule from the diff against lab-base (untracked files included, the overlay CLAUDE.md ignored): deps = changed package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml or tsconfig*.json; outside_pkg = changed files outside the packages the task needs (h1 frai-gate; h2 frai-core, frai-cli; h3 and h4 frai-core, frai-cli, frai-agent), with the root README.md and package READMEs allowed for every task; any = net new any-type uses in .ts/.js source (dist skipped); deleted = files gone since lab-base (a move counts). The rule text still says 'the package the task names' (the brief's wording); the hard prompts name the packages or entry points they need, and the checker uses the allowed sets above. The rules are generic and were checked against the four hard prompts and reference patches: they mention nothing about field parsing, thresholds, .env handling, option parsing or import matching. Upper-case vs normal case is day 25 and negative wording is day 27, not this test. Task set and model changed on 15 Sep 2026 after the pilots (see PROTOCOL): t1, t2, t3 and h2 on Haiku 4.5, both sides.
